title: Decision-making components and times revealed by the single-trial electroencephalogram
goal: Recreate all126 original Table1 author findings and exceed preselected strongest author comparators using one arbitrary candidate across all18 original target×instruction errors. Original Table 1 fixed-HMP-target prediction task across all nine targets and both instructions. Reproduction recreates the complete three-author-law panel: 54 held-contrast RMSE references, 54 full-fit latency R² references and 18 Fechner accuracy R² companions. Improvement evaluates one arbitrary candidate method on the 18 target×instruction cells against the strongest relevant original author law preselected separately for each cell before inspecting candidate performance; three candidate law variants are not required. Original fixed targets, B/H populations, source contrast folds and complete support are unchanged. Broader EEG event discovery, mixed effects and ERP/CPP findings remain separately named reproduction.
primary_outputs: Selected reproduction: complete126 author Table1 references, independently derived from authentic original fixedHMP targets, source B/H populations and original source law protocols.

Selected improvement:18 matched candidate RMSE values against preselected strongest relevant author law per target×instruction cell; three candidate law variants are not required. Valid joint superiority remains unresolved.

Separately retained biological reproduction: Original five-event discovery, timing/topography, Table2 mixed effects, ERP and CPP/decision-accuracy findings. Preserve Table1 encoding Pieron R² speed0.57/accuracy0.30 versus Results speed0.53/accuracy0.34 discrepancy; never mix references.
success_criteria: Reproduce the complete selected original endpoint from authentic source observations and independently verified derived outputs.

Exceed preselected strongest relevant author comparators on all18 original target×instruction cells under a justified joint decision; preserve full source support and separately reproduce all126 author references.
Keep reproduction and improvement independent and both assistance conditions matched except declared official source access.
No runtime, result, paper win or current-SOTA claim follows from this scope construction.
All concrete source, reference, exposure, tolerance and execution gaps in primary-endpoint-v1 remain blocking.

retained_prior_scope_holds.interpretation: Preserved source, observation, exposure and execution restrictions apply within their retained scope. primary_source_limits: Exact cleaned-epoch and participant identities, EEG/RT masks, HMP output lineage and original inference/reference artifacts remain unqualified. Historical correct-only wording versus the source all-responded selection must be reconciled through source fidelity, not automatically restored.

Preserve source participant scaling, pooled covariance/PCA, event width, event/interval identities and source cumulative-fit event discovery using all participants and conditions. A new held-out event-selection score is not an authenticated original comparator.

Preserve both speed/accuracy conditions, source contrast/instruction coding and separate topography, mixed-model and ERP cluster procedures. Participant is the biological unit; trials and event estimates are nested observations.

Preserve the Table 1 fixed targets, complete target/condition/law cells, per-participant fits and contrast-left-out reductions. Changing HMP targets, participants, condition selection or sampling rate changes the comparison.

The authenticated Results report encoding Pieron R2 of 0.53 and 0.34, while literal Table 1 reports 0.57 and 0.30 for speed/accuracy. Preserve table-specific reference values within their named result and retain the paragraph/table discrepancy; do not silently mix or select favorable magnitudes.

Primary numerical agreement criteria and scientifically justified same-result superiority remain unresolved. Larger effects, smaller p-values or better prediction of fixed latent targets do not by themselves improve the complete empirical finding.

No explicit task-specific authority to replace the retained family with Table 1 alone was found in the bounded inspected records. A documented reviewed revision must be assessed on its actual terms; actively promoting Table 1 to sole primary is a new scientific scope choice.

Do not admit a complete-family reproduction/partial-component improvement bundle as complete-primary success if the schema cannot express its coverage relationship. Preserve the valid 126-value panel, scorer, source evidence and prior scoped reviews.
